text:
Type: five-tier ladder bookshelf
Use: displaying books, plants and decor; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: solid rubber wood frame, walnut finish
Colors: dark warm walnut brown
Shape: tall leaning A-frame, five shelves graduating deeper toward the base, angled side rails, open back, narrow footprint, slim and light
Feel: warm, orderly, understated
Goes with: white or beige walls, brass or black accents, light upholstery; modern, transitional or mid-century rooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Modern 5-Tier Ladder Bookshelf Organizer with Solid Rubber Wood Frame, Walnut
product.description: 5-tier ladder-style bookcase for placing keepsakes, decor, books, awards, and more Descending design with shelf widths widening at the bottom Straight back allows you to place bookcase neatly against a wall; angled front saves space Solid rubber wood frame; each shelf holds 25 pounds Minimal, modern design complements a variety of interior aesthetics Easy to assemble with provided instructions and hardware Bookshelf Dimensions: 24.8 x 14 x 70.1 inches (WxDxH)
